newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to deal strictly with Nomura -- Mitsuzuka.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to deal strictly with Nomura -- Mitsuzuka.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry will administer strict penalties against Nomura Securities Co Ltd after it has held talks with the brokerage, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a group of reporters on Tuesday.

He added that an alliance announced earlier on Tuesday between Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and the Swiss Bank Corp group was likely to boost confidence in LTCB, while such alliances by Japanese banks are likely to become a trend as a result of Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms.
"It is up to management's judgment to form alliances, but I think such moves are likely to become a trend in the future," Mitsuzuka said.

Regarding Nomura, he said the ministry will decide what kind of penalties to impose on the scandal-hit brokerage after scrutinising legal precedents and recommendations made by Japan's Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) earlier on Tuesday.
